# Future Ammunition - 40mm Support

`ghost_fa_grenade_40mm`

HuntIR-style delivery. Pops a parachute at the round's apex and lets the payload float down, then runs the effect function at the landing point. The carrier never explodes — it is deleted at apex by fnc_handle and this chute carries the effect the rest of the way.
